info.title: Breakreach API
info.description:
Publish and schedule social media posts across Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Mastodon, WordPress, Ghost, Dev.to, Hashnode and Tumblr with one request shape.

Authenticate with an API key (create one in the Breakreach dashboard under Settings → API & MCP) sent as a Bearer token. Errors answer with an HTTP status and a JSON body { "error": "<reason>" }.

Every POST accepts an Idempotency-Key header: any unique string up to 255 characters, a UUID for instance. Retrying with the same key and the same body within 24 hours returns the first response, marked Idempotent-Replayed: true, instead of creating a second post. The same key with a different body answers 422, and 409 while the first request is still running. Errors are not kept, so a fixed request can reuse its key. Keys belong to the API key that sent them.

AI agents can use the same capabilities through the hosted MCP server at https://api.breakreach.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1).

post.description: Creates a workspace owned by the API key's user, with the default posting schedule. A workspace per end customer keeps their accounts, posts and connect links apart. Counts toward the plan's workspace limit (100 on the Developer plan).

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to read scheduledAt, e.g. Europe/Paris (default UTC)

400.description: Missing or too long name, unknown timezone

402.description: Workspace limit of the plan reached

post.description: Creates a hosted page where someone without a Breakreach login (your end user, your client) connects social accounts into a workspace. Send them the url; they pick a network, authorize it, and come back to the page, then to redirectUrl when they click Done, with ?connected=<platforms>&workspace=<slug> appended. Accounts connected this way fire the account.connected webhook and count toward your plan. Only the workspace owner can create links.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional, defaults to your first workspace)

platforms.description: Networks offered on the page (default: all)

redirectUrl.description: Where the Done button sends them: https, or http on localhost

400.description: Unknown platform, invalid redirectUrl or expiresInHours

get.description: Its status (active, expired or revoked) and the accounts connected through it. The url is only returned when the link is created.

delete.description: The page stops working at once. Accounts already connected through it stay connected.

get.description: Returns the connected accounts of the workspace. Use the returned ids as accountIds when creating posts.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Workspace slug (defaults to your first workspace)

message.description: Present only when no account is connected: explains how to connect one, with the link to the workspace settings

post.summary: Create a post (schedule, publish now or save a draft)
post.description: Creates a post targeting one or several connected accounts. Provide scheduledAt (interpreted in the workspace timezone), or set useNextSlot to schedule at the next free slot of the workspace posting schedule, or publishNow to publish immediately. Set draft to save it for review in Breakreach without scheduling it: a draft needs no publish time (scheduledAt, if given, places it on the calendar), skips the media checks, and goes out only once it is scheduled, in the app or with PATCH /v1/posts/{id}. Media must be public URLs — use POST /v1/media first for reliable hosting. Media is required for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest. On Instagram one photo is a feed post, one video a Reel, and 2 to 10 files (photos and videos, in order) a carousel whose photos are all cropped to the first photo's shape. Facebook Pages take up to 10 photos in one post, or one video. LinkedIn posts one MP4 video alone, or turns 2 to 20 photos into a carousel (a PDF document, one page per photo, all cropped to the first photo's shape, titled with the first line), and posts a PDF URL as a document. Pinterest takes one image or one MP4/MOV video; an image sent with the video becomes its cover.

content.description: The post text. For Reddit, the first line becomes the title.

scheduledAt.description: ISO datetime in the workspace timezone, e.g. 2026-09-20T11:00:00

draft.description: Save as a draft for review instead of scheduling it. Can't be combined with publishNow

pinterestBoardId.description: Required when targeting Pinterest — see GET /v1/pinterest-boards

pinterestLink.description: Destination URL of the pin (optional, http(s), up to 2,048 characters). The pin title is the first line of content

redditSubreddit.description: Subreddit without r/ — defaults to the user profile

redditFlairText.description: Post flair name when the subreddit requires one

400.description: Validation error: missing content, accountIds or publish time, an account outside the workspace, missing media or pinterestBoardId, invalid scheduledAt or pinterestLink

404.description: Workspace not found, or useNextSlot found no free slot

patch.summary: Edit, schedule or move back to drafts
patch.description: Edits a draft, scheduled or failed post. Only the fields you send change. Sending scheduledAt, useNextSlot or publishNow schedules the post: a draft goes out at that time, a failed post is retried. draft: true moves a scheduled post back to drafts so it won't publish. Published posts can't be edited.

scheduledAt.description: ISO datetime in the workspace timezone, e.g. 2026-09-20T11:00:00

draft.description: true moves the post back to drafts

400.description: Post already published, empty content or accountIds, draft combined with publishNow, missing media or pinterestBoardId once scheduled, invalid scheduledAt

404.description: Post or workspace not found, or useNextSlot found no free slot

post.summary: Re-host a media URL on Breakreach storage
post.description: Downloads an image or video from a public URL and hosts it permanently, so it stays available for scheduled posts. Returns the hosted URL to use in POST /v1/posts.

400.description: Missing or non-http(s) URL, or the media could not be downloaded

post.summary: Upload a local file to Breakreach storage
post.description: Hosts an image, video or PDF sent as multipart/form-data in a field named file (up to 100 MB): JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, WebM or PDF, recognised by the file name's extension. Returns the hosted URL to use in POST /v1/posts. For a file already online, POST /v1/media takes its URL.

400.description: No file in a field named file, unsupported file type, or over 100 MB

get.description: Returns the earliest future time slot from the workspace posting schedule that has no post scheduled yet.

scheduledAt.description: Local time in the workspace timezone, to pass as scheduledAt

404.description: Workspace not found, no posting schedule configured, or no free slot in the next 14 days
Workspace not found, or no Pinterest account connected

502.description: Pinterest did not return the boards: reconnecting the account usually fixes it

get.description: Aggregated views, likes, comments and shares across the last 100 published posts, plus the top 10 posts by views.
Follower counts and account-level totals for every connected account, where the platform exposes them. Cached up to 1 hour.

Everything about one post on a connected account, including posts not published with Breakreach: content, every lifetime metric the platform exposes (views, reach, reactions by type, clicks, saves, watch time, retention curve...), comments, and a comparison with the account's average. accountId and postId (platform post id) come from /v1/performance.

400.description: Missing or invalid accountId, or missing postId

404.description: Workspace, account or post not found

get.description: Daily account-level insights over the last N days (max 90): Facebook Pages (views, engagement, total followers), Instagram (reach) and Threads (views), with a summary per account. Cached up to 1 hour.
Views, likes, comments and shares for one post, plus the platform post ids it published to.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Fetch fresh metrics from the platforms before answering, instead of the last stored ones

get.summary: Read comments on a published post
get.description: Live comments/replies from the platforms. Supported: Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X. Each comment carries the accountId and platform needed to reply. YouTube is not listed yet: its comments need a restricted Google permission (youtube.force-ssl) that is not available to every account.

400.description: The post has no published platform ids yet

get.description: Comments on the latest 10 posts of every connected Instagram, Facebook and Threads account, including posts not published with Breakreach, plus replies to X posts published with Breakreach. Newest first. Each comment carries the accountId and platform needed to reply. YouTube is not listed yet: its comments need a restricted Google permission (youtube.force-ssl) that is not available to every account.

post.description: Replies to a comment on a published post. Supported: Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X. YouTube is not listed yet: its comments need a restricted Google permission (youtube.force-ssl) that is not available to every account.

get.description: Per-post views, likes, comments, shares and engagement rate over the last N days (max 365), with totals per platform. Covers all posts on connected Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, YouTube and Bluesky accounts, including posts not made with Breakreach. Cached up to 1 hour.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Rebuild from the platforms instead of the cache

get.description: Conversations on connected Facebook Pages (Messenger), Instagram and X accounts, newest first. Accounts whose messages can't be loaded are returned in errors with the reason.
Messages of one conversation, oldest first. participantId is required for X.

400.description: Missing or invalid accountId, unsupported platform, or participantId missing for X

502.description: The platform did not return the messages

post.description: Replies in a conversation. Instagram and Messenger only accept replies within 24 hours of the person's last message. participantId is required for X.

400.description: Missing message or accountId, unsupported platform, or participantId missing for X

get.description: Comment to DM automations: when someone comments a keyword on a post of an Instagram account or a Facebook Page (or any post of it), Breakreach sends them a DM through a private reply (Instagram Direct, or Messenger from the Page), and optionally a public reply under the comment. Both networks allow one private reply per comment within 7 days of it, and Breakreach sends each person one DM per rule.

post.summary: Create a Comment to DM rule
post.description: Starts watching the comments of the account (Breakreach subscribes it to Instagram's comment webhooks, or the Page's feed webhooks). Requires an active plan or trial on the workspace.

400.description: Invalid field, not an Instagram account or a Facebook Page, or the post isn't on this account

404.description: Account, post or workspace not found

502.description: Instagram refused to read the account or to send its comments

get.summary: Latest posts of an Instagram account or a Facebook Page
get.description: The account's latest posts with their ids, to pick the mediaId of a rule.

400.description: Not an Instagram account or a Facebook Page

502.description: The network did not return the posts

patch.summary: Update a Comment to DM rule
patch.description: Only the fields given change. active false pauses the rule; mediaId null makes it watch every post.

delete.summary: Delete a Comment to DM rule
delete.description: Deletes the rule with its activity.

get.summary: Activity of a Comment to DM rule
get.description: Comments that matched the rule, newest first, kept 90 days: sent, failed (with the reason) or skipped. The same outcomes are pushed to webhooks subscribed to comment_dm.sent and comment_dm.failed.

DM automations: when someone DMs a keyword, mentions the account in their story, replies to a story or opens a ref link, Breakreach answers in Instagram Direct (or Messenger for a Facebook Page) and walks a flow of messages, waits, conditions and handoffs for that person. Replies only go out within Meta's 24-hour window after the person's last message; a person is in one flow at a time, and someone answering by hand stops it.

post.description: Subscribes the account to Meta's message webhooks and starts answering. Requires an active plan or trial on the workspace.

400.description: Invalid trigger or step (the message says which), or not an Instagram account or a Facebook Page

502.description: Meta refused to subscribe the account

patch.description: Only the fields given change; steps replaces the whole flow (keep the ids of unchanged steps so people in the flow carry on). active false pauses it and stops the people in it.

delete.description: Deletes the automation with its runs; people in the flow stop.

get.description: Each person who went through it, newest first, kept 90 days: every step sent, choices tapped, clicks, and how it ended. Webhooks subscribed to dm_automation.started, dm_automation.handoff, dm_automation.finished and dm_automation.failed get the same events as they happen.

bearerAuth.description: API key from the Breakreach dashboard (br_...) or an OAuth access token (bro_...)

error.description: Human-readable failure reason when status is failed

warning.description: Present when the account's authorization has expired, was revoked on the network's side, or expires soon (LinkedIn lasts about 60 days): the user must reconnect it in Breakreach settings

ArticleSettings.description: Options for the blog networks (Dev.to, Hashnode, Ghost, Tumblr). On Dev.to, Hashnode and Ghost the first line of content is the title and the rest the body, in Markdown; the first photo is the cover

tags.description: Dev.to keeps the first 4 (letters and digits), Hashnode 15, Ghost and Tumblr up to 30

canonicalUrl.description: Where the article was first published, when this is a copy (Dev.to, Hashnode, Ghost)

asDraft.description: Create it as an unpublished draft on the blog instead of publishing it

newsletter.description: Ghost: also email the post with this newsletter (its slug, or "default" for the site's first active one)

emailSegment.description: Ghost newsletter: who gets the email (default all members)

aiDisclosure.description: Dev.to: how much AI wrote the article (Dev.to asks API clients to say so accurately)

status.description: publishing when publishNow was set, draft when draft was set

url.description: The page to send, only returned at creation

mediaId.description: The Instagram or Facebook post the rule watches; null = every post of the account

keywords.description: Empty = every comment triggers the rule

accountId.description: Instagram account or Facebook Page id from /v1/accounts (create only, a rule can't change account)

mediaId.description: Instagram or Facebook post id to watch (from /v1/comment-dm-rules/media or the postId of /v1/comments). Omit or null for every post

postId.description: Instead of mediaId: a Breakreach post id published on this account

keywords.description: Words or phrases that trigger the DM, case and accents ignored. Empty = every comment

match.description: contains = the keyword appears as a whole word or phrase; exact = the comment is just the keyword (punctuation and emoji around it ignored)

dmText.description: The DM sent to the commenter, links allowed. {username} becomes their @handle on Instagram, their first name on Facebook. Required on create

publicReplies.description: Optional public replies under the comment once the DM is sent, one picked at random. {username} becomes their @handle on Instagram, their first name on Facebook

reason.description: Why it was skipped: duplicate (the person already got this rule's DM), too_old (Instagram allows private replies within 7 days), plan (no active plan), paused, deleted

publicReply.description: The public reply posted under the comment

type.description: keyword = a DM containing a keyword; any_message = any DM (welcome or away reply); story_mention = someone mentions the account in their story (Instagram); story_reply = a reply to one of its stories, optionally with keywords (Instagram); ref = someone opens ig.me/m/<username>?ref=<ref> or m.me/<page id>?ref=<ref> and writes

keywords.description: keyword (required) and story_reply (optional); case and accents ignored

DmStep.description: One step of a flow. A message with choices, a condition and a handoff must be the last step of their list; what follows goes inside their branches. Up to 40 steps, branches 6 levels deep.

id.description: Kept across edits so people in the flow carry on; generated when omitted

text.description: message: up to 1000 bytes (640 characters with a button). {username} = their @handle on Instagram, first name on Messenger; {first_name}

button.description: message: a link button; clicks are counted (the link goes through api.breakreach.com/l/...)

choices.description: message: quick-reply choices, each with its own steps. Not with a button

otherwise.description: message with choices: a typed answer that isn't a choice, or no answer within afterMinutes

check.description: condition: a reply, a reply containing keywords, a click on an earlier link button (each waited for up to withinMinutes), or whether they follow the account (Instagram, checked at once)

refLink.description: For a ref trigger: the link to share (link in bio, QR code, ad)

accountId.description: Instagram account or Facebook Page id from /v1/accounts (create only)

steps.description: Required on create. On update, the whole list

reentry.description: once = a person goes through it once; always = each time they trigger it, at most once per cooldownHours

kind.description: trigger, sent, choice, reply, click, branch, wait, waited, handoff, end, error

endReason.description: done, handoff, human_replied (someone answered by hand), window (Meta's 24-hour window closed), paused, deleted, flow_changed, stopped_by_team, send, account

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this request, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the first response (with the header Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of running again. Printable ASCII, no spaces.

IdempotencyRunning.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running: retry after Retry-After seconds to get its response

IdempotencyMismatch.description: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request in the last 24 hours

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key

PaymentRequired.description: No active Breakreach subscription or trial

Forbidden.description: Not a member of the requested workspace
